item: ТЗ-97 Q12 (строка 7) in this commit: tests/test_task65_k4_firsthour.py carried the `firsthour` marker, which pyproject addopts deselects, so the scenario that is supposed to redden on its own never ran in acceptance. Measured offline: `1 passed in 11.39s` (Run 86), under the row's 60 s line, so the marker came off; pyproject keeps the declaration and the addopts exclusion because tests/test_desktop_f2_double_click.py still wears it, and the marker description was corrected to name that file instead of K4.
step: Row 7 done on evidence: before the edit `-m firsthour tests/test_task65_k4_firsthour.py` = 1 passed in 11.46s, after it the same file in the default configuration = 1 passed in 11.39s, with neighbours test_cli.py + test_desktop_window.py = 77 passed in 21.02s, and `--collect-only -m firsthour` now collects 2 tests, both from the f2 .app build. The cost of the change is that the suite got 11 s heavier and K4 now runs under the Q11 HOME substitution: batch with tests/test_task97_q11_home_clean.py + the report/guide/docs guards = 51 passed, 1 skipped, 2 deselected in 16.42s (Run 87), i.e. K4 does not write into the substituted HOME the way the PyInstaller cache does (Disputed 11). Q4 (18f92c3) stands: acceptance 13/0, pushed. Next in TASK-97 order: Q12 row 2 — «Собрать» on a non-demo ticker runs rusterm follow in the background with stage output in the window, demo path unchanged, offscreen tooth on the tests/data stub transport.
